title: oxalis grayi
intro: Oxalis grayi, commonly known as the wood sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include supporting urinary tract health, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis grayi include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
